name: GET /web/loginDone before any authorization fails with 500 'No access token for the default user'

source.reference: oauth2-authorization-code-using-the-HTTP-connector/src/main/app/http-authorization-code-web.xml (http:request on HTTP_Request_Configuration_HTTPS with oauth2:authorization-code-grant-type); Mule 3.8 DefaultAuthorizationCodeGrantType#authenticate throws RequestAuthenticationException 'No access token for the %s user...' for resource owner 'default'; HttpMessageProcessorTemplate#sendFailureResponseToClient answers 500 with the exception message

expected.body: ~.*No access token for the default user\. Verify that you have authenticated the user before trying to execute an operation to the API\..*
